📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter how many terms N you want (up to 5000).
  2. Choose whether to start 0, 1 or 1, 1.
  3. Press Generate to list the sequence and the nth term.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is fast doubling?
Identities F(2k) and F(2k+1) expressed through F(k) compute the nth term in O(log n) steps instead of O(n).
Why BigInt?
F(100) already has 21 digits — far past float precision. BigInt keeps every term exact.
Where does the golden ratio come in?
The ratio of consecutive Fibonacci numbers converges to φ ≈ 1.6180339887.
